content:
The test image shows a plant stem with young leaves exhibiting:
- **Brown/necrotic tips** on multiple leaves
- Necrosis progressing from the leaf/shoot tips backward
- Otherwise green stem and base tissue
- No white powdery coating (rules out Powdery_Mildew)
- No black sooty layer (rules out Sooty_Mould)
- No galls or swellings (rules out Gall_Midge)
- No clean-cut stem damage (rules out Cutting_Weevil)

The pattern of browning and dying tissue starting at the shoot tips and progressing back is the hallmark of **Die_Back** — where vascular blockage or fungal infection causes progressive shoot death from tip downward.
